messages:
matt: flagging an urgent allocation issue - PO RW-2026-510. Vendor Park says original shipment of 24 H100s to EU pool split by forwarder. 18 units stuck at FRA for serial/manifest mismatch + 6 marked with thermal-damage stickers. We need a triage decision: accept partial air top-off (A800s) from APAC substitution, or insist vendor cures H100s. Impacts: cluster provisioning for NL+FRA regions.

julie: ouch. can we get AWB and forwarder note? also what's the lead time delta if vendor re-queues replacements?

matt: AWB: 987-6543210. Forwarder note attached to thread (they flagged `manifest_trim.csv`). Vendor says replacements if re-queued will be ~28 days.

eva: quick inventory cross-check (staging snapshot):
```
$ awk '/RW-2026-510/ {print $0}' /srv/staging/serials.log
H100-7712 OK -> depot NL pool
H100-7713 SERIAL_MISMATCH -> vendor manifest truncated
H100-7714 THERMAL_STICKER -> photo evidence attached
H100-7715 OK
... (rest truncated)
```

andrew: options: 1) vendor re-issue corrected commercial invoice + customs release (slow, 2-4d to reconcile docs, but then all 24 clear), 2) vendor partial air-express for confirmed-good serials -> NL depot + escrow note for disputed serials, 3) accept APAC A800 top-off (faster) but risk model mismatch / ROI delta. Cost estimates?

vendor-park: we can do partial air-express for up to 12 H100s same-day from FRA to NL; freight + customs paperwork EUR 2,200. We'll provide notarized serial reconciliation within 36h and photo evidence for thermal stickers. If you opt for APAC A800s substitution: 24 A800s available for immediate air at EUR 1,700 per unit landed (higher unit cost). Re-issue invoice with corrected serials available but full re-clear may take 3 business days with customs.

julie: finance needs decision threshold. Andrew, can ops cover EUR 2,200 from provisioning cushion? If we accept A800s we need procurement sign-off on cost delta.

finance-bot: created ticket FIN-9901 to pre-approve expedite spend up to EUR 3,000 for procurement emergencies. Link: https://redwood-internal/finance/FIN-9901 :white_check_mark:

andrew: approve up to EUR 2,200 from ops cushion for partial air-express. Priorities: keep NL cluster online; route to NL depot intake SLA 48h. For the 6 thermal-stickered units, request on-site inspection report + insurance claim estimate; vendor to confirm if DOA or cosmetic.

vendor-park: confirmed: AWB split -> 987-6543210-A (12 expedited), 987-6543210-B (held FRA). NL depot intake SLA 48h after arrival. FRA inspection est 24-72h; if DOA -> RMA flow starts, we'll absorb standard RMA shipping but insurer to confirm coverage for thermal damage. Notarized serial file `serials_corrected.pdf` will be uploaded to OPS ticket EOD.

ops-bot: created OPS ticket OPS-8349 to track AWB split, expedite payment, FRA inspection photos, and RMA initiation. Link: https://redwood-internal/ops/OPS-8349

matt: noted. I'll attach the `manifest_trim.csv` and the staging grep output to OPS-8349. Julie please loop procurement on A800 substitution contingency but for now we proceed with partial air-express.

julie: looping @procurement-team. procurement: if vendor later claims shortage because 12 were expedited, we want written acceptance of split and liability statement. also require insurer contact.

vendor-park: we will provide written split acceptance and insurer contact. Also offering a 1% freight credit if you keep the held units after inspection and accept replacement timeline.

eva: thanks everyone. Andrew -> please trigger payment EUR 2,200 and cc finance. Closing note: prefer H100s but accept partial expedite to avoid capacity regression. Will close thread after OPS-8349 has notarized serials and FRA inspection outcome. :thumbsup:
